discription: A warm saw wave pad sound with a low-pass filter and vibrato.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=5000, rq=0.5, vibRate=5, vibDepth=0.01;    var sig, env, filterEnv, lfo;    env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 1.5, 0.7, 2.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2);    filterEnv = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate);    lfo = SinOsc.kr(vibRate) * vibDepth * freq;    sig = Saw.ar(freq + lfo);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff * (0.2 + 0.8 * filterEnv).clip(0.01, 1), rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
